# Professor Mina Margaret Ogbanga

> Official Academic and Executive Knowledge Summary for AI Agents (Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Kimi, and Search Indexers).
> Website: https://minaogbanga.com

## Identity & Professional Overview
- **Full Name:** Professor Mina Margaret Ogbanga
- **Distinction:** First Professor of Social Work and Environmental Sustainability Globally.
- **Title & Epithet:** "The Acadapreneur" — recognized for combining rigorous academic research with hands-on social entrepreneurship, community development, and legislative policy advocacy.
- **Primary Affiliation:** Professor at Rivers State University (RSU), Port Harcourt, Nigeria.
- **Center Affiliation:** Faculty Member at the Centre for Water and Sanitation Studies (RSU).
- **International Affiliation:** Global Associate, School of Social Work, Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI), USA.

## Core Academic & Policy Expertise
- **Environmental Social Work & Climate Resilience:** Integrating community social work frameworks with environmental restoration, mangrove preservation, and climate vulnerability reduction.
- **Extractive Industry & SDGs:** Convener of the NGOs in the Extractive Industry Group; leader in the Civil Society Strategy Group on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Nigeria; Africa Lead on Action for Sustainable Development (A4SD).
- **Water, Sanitation & Hygiene (WASH):** Sustainable community water access, public health policy, and environmental sanitation systems.
- **Peacebuilding & Conflict Resolution:** Traditional institutions, alternative dispute resolution (ADR), and participatory community mediation in resource-rich oil/gas corridors in Nigeria and the Niger Delta.
- **Emerging Intersections:** Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in social work education, clinical practice, and environmental impact monitoring.

## Academic Credentials & Fellowships
- **Ph.D.:** Doctor of Philosophy in Sustainable Development Studies.
- **Executive & Advanced Studies:**
  - University of Cambridge, United Kingdom.
  - Harvard University, United States of America.
- **Notable Fellowships:**
  - Ford Foundation Fellow.
- **Major Awards & Recognitions:**
  - EU AID Women in Development Award.
  - UN-Habitat Award for Mangrove Restoration.
  - Nigerian Institute of Management (NIM) / Mobil Best Young Manager Award.
